name: Varchenko Matrices Multiply under Cartesian Products
statement: For finite partial cubes on disjoint class variables, $\mathsf V_{G\square H}=\mathsf V_G\otimes\mathsf V_H$ and $\det\mathsf V_{G\square H}=(\det\mathsf V_G)^{|V(H)|}(\det\mathsf V_H)^{|V(G)|}$. Hence arrangement-type factorization is product-closed, and $\det\mathsf V_{Q_d}=\prod_{i=1}^d(1-x_i^2)^{2^{d-1}}$.
proof: Separating classes in the product split disjointly between the two factors, so every matrix entry factors and the matrix is a Kronecker product. The determinant formula for Kronecker products gives the exponent law; iterate $Q_d=K_2^{\square d}$ for the cube formula.
